title: Annotatio III §.IV: Sole known figure of Christ — that given in the Sacred Eucharist / consecrated bread
pass_a_gloss: With a most express reason annexed: that to the true Christian Church nothing had ever become known concerning any other Figure of Christ except that which is given in the Sacred Eucharist and is conspicuous in the consecrated Bread. For so Sagittarius, Epitomator of the Councils, sets forth the mind and Constitution of the Constantinopolitans.
pass_b_english: Annexed reason, most express: the true Church never knew any other Figure of Christ than the one given in the Sacred Eucharist and seen in the consecrated Bread.
Sagittarius (council epitomator) reports the Constantinopolitans’ mind and constitution so.
source_text: Subnexâ ratione disertissimâ, quòd veræ Christianæ Ecclesiæ de nulla alia Christi Figura, quicquam unquam innotuisset, præterquam ea, quæ in S. Eucharistia detur, inque Pane consecrato conspicua sit. Sic enim Conciliorum Epitomator Sagittarius Constantinopolitanorum mentem ac Constitutionem edisserit.
